mapper.select: SELECT FROM players WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE players SET gold = #{gold}, current_tower_id = #{currentTowerId}, current_floor = #{currentFloor}, target_floor = #{targetFloor}, tower_mode = #{towerMode}, current_enemy_id = #{currentEnemyId}, current_enemy_hp = #{currentEnemyHp}, run_gold = #{runGold}, highest_floor = #{highestFloor}, last_tick_at = #{lastTickAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO players (id, user_id, gold, current_tower_id, current_floor, target_floor, tower_mode, hp_threshold, current_enemy_id, current_enemy_hp, run_gold, highest_floor, last_tick_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{gold}, #{currentTowerId}, #{currentFloor}, #{targetFloor}, #{towerMode}, #{hpThreshold}, #{currentEnemyId}, #{currentEnemyHp}, #{runGold}, #{highestFloor}, #{lastTickAt}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO player_settings (id, player_id, potion_threshold, battle_log_count, toast_enabled, auto_sell_rarity) VALUES (#{id}, #{playerId}, #{potionThreshold}, #{battleLogCount}, #{toastEnabled}, #{autoSellRarity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, player_id, item_id, quantity FROM inventory_items WHERE player_id = #{playerId} ORDER BY item_id
